accounting.rationale: Integer kind constants mix fixed validity/sentinel obligations with processor-dependent positive kind values.
Positive numeric kind values are processor choices.
Real and complex kind constants mix validity/sentinel obligations, mandated equalities, and processor-dependent positive kind values.
Positive real and complex kind numeric values are processor choices.
C_BOOL mixes valid-kind or sentinel obligation with processor-dependent positive kind value.
Positive C_BOOL numeric kind value is processor-dependent.
C_CHAR mixes valid-kind or sentinel obligation with processor-dependent nonnegative kind value.
Nonnegative C_CHAR numeric kind value is processor-dependent.
The paragraph states normative properties and value table linkage, plus an explanatory C-semantics reference.
The final sentence points to ISO C explanations of the special-character semantics.
Cross-reference to the C_PTR and C_FUNPTR descriptions in 18.3.2.
The NOTE cross-references NEW_LINE and is not normative.

Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; kind constants are used only under positive guards, and every standardized name is enumerated. Source accounting only.
